name: new-project
description: /new-project bootstraps a repository from the claude-improvements baselines: asks the kickoff questions, copies the web, Rust or Python template, writes CLAUDE.md and the stack ADR, then installs and runs verify

baselines.title: Baselines folder
baselines.description: The baselines folder of a claude-improvements checkout (it holds general/kickoff.md), as an absolute path or one starting with ~/. Leave empty when the mod runs from that checkout
